## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Scope and boundaries

- P0 document(s) affected:
- Product boundary impact:
- Security/privacy impact:
- New production dependencies and network behavior, if any:

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm lint:ast`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm build:desktop`
- [ ] Relevant real Chrome/Native Host checks, or an explanation of why they do not apply

## Data hygiene

- [ ] No real page captures, browsing data, credentials, private URLs, or generated Native Host files are included
- [ ] New fixtures are synthetic
- [ ] Known limitations and uncovered page types are documented
